profile.name: James Pasternak
profile.bio: James Pasternak was first elected to Toronto City Council in 2010, representing Ward 10 York Centre; he had previously served as a Toronto District School Board trustee from 2006 to 2010. He has represented Ward 6 York Centre since the 2018 ward boundary changes, and was re-elected in 2014, 2018 and 2022. He holds degrees from York University, the University of Western Ontario, and the London School of Economics and Political Science.
committees: Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board of Directors

promises.text: Commit to responsible budgeting while expanding affordable housing options and easing the cost of living for Ward 6 families.
Improve city parks, recreation programs, and services for seniors so every resident can thrive in the Ward 6 community.

expensesDetailSource.name: Council Expense Routine Disclosure — Constituency Services & Office Expenses
expensesDetailSource.publisher: City Clerk's Office, City of Toronto
expensesDetailSource.note: Figures are the City's routine disclosure of constituency services and office expenses, shown as published, by category, from 2013. This is a separate publication from the annual remuneration reports in expenses.json, with a narrower scope — office spending only, not pay, benefits or staff salaries — and the two are never added together. Amounts shown as personal funds are the member's own money, as the City reports it. Invoice-level documents stay on the City's site; category amounts link to them.
